paragraphs.en: OpenCut is being rewritten from the ground up. What's coming:
paragraphs.zh: OpenCut 正在从零开始重写。即将推出的内容：

paragraphs.en: You can still find the previous version at opencut-app/opencut-classic , which is the one to reach for today. opencut.app still runs the classic version. The rewrite will live at new.opencut.app until it's ready to take over.
paragraphs.zh: 你仍然可以在 opencut-app/opencut-classic 找到之前的版本，这也是目前应该使用的版本。opencut.app 上运行的仍是经典版本。 重写版在正式接替之前将托管在 new.opencut.app 上。

sents.en: The rewrite will live at new.opencut.app until it's ready to take over.

paragraphs.en: irm https: // moonrepo.dev / install / proto.ps1 | iex If shims fail to run, allow local scripts for your user:
paragraphs.zh: irm https://moonrepo.dev/install/proto.ps1 | iex 如果 shim 无法运行，请为你的用户允许运行本地脚本：

paragraphs.en: Set-ExecutionPolicy - Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned From the repo root:
paragraphs.zh: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned 在仓库根目录下执行：

paragraphs.en: proto use # installs the tools pinned in .prototools moon run web:dev # localhost:5173 moon run api:dev # localhost:8787 moon run desktop:dev # see apps/desktop/README.md Contributing We're not set up to take outside contributions yet while the architecture is being designed. If you want to follow along, ask questions, or just hang out, join the Discord or open an issue .
paragraphs.zh: proto use # 安装 .prototools 中固定的工具 moon run web:dev # localhost:5173 moon run api:dev # localhost:8787 moon run desktop:dev # 参见 apps/desktop/README.md 参与贡献 在架构设计阶段，我们尚未开放接受外部贡献。 如果你想跟进进展、提问，或者只是想一起聊聊，欢迎加入 Discord 或提交一个 issue。

paragraphs.en: OpenCut is supported by companies that believe in open source creator tools.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCut 由那些相信开源创作者工具的公司提供支持。
